pipeline:
SELECT 'pipeline' AS kind, s.name, work.identity, work.request_id, work.position
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS s(name text, contract_sha256 text, receipt_subject_id text)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT r.identity, (receipt->'intent')->>'request_id' AS request_id, ((encode(sha256(decode(r.identity,'hex')),'hex')||'p') COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM public.gregale_pipeline_tool_starts r
 WHERE (receipt->'intent')->'scope'=$2::jsonb AND (receipt->'intent')->>'owner_id'=$3 AND (receipt->'intent')->>'name'=s.name AND (receipt->'intent')->>'subject_id'=COALESCE(s.receipt_subject_id,$4) AND (receipt->'intent')->>'contract_sha256'=s.contract_sha256 AND ((encode(sha256(decode(r.identity,'hex')),'hex')||'p') COLLATE "C") > $5::text COLLATE "C"
 ORDER BY ((encode(sha256(decode(r.identity,'hex')),'hex')||'p') COLLATE "C") LIMIT $6
) work
ORDER BY work.position COLLATE "C" LIMIT $6
action:
SELECT 'action' AS kind, s.name, work.identity, work.request_id, work.position
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS s(name text, contract_sha256 text)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT r.identity, intent->>'request_id' AS request_id, ((encode(sha256(decode(r.identity,'hex')),'hex')||'a') COLLATE "C") AS position
 FROM public.gregale_outbound_actions r
 WHERE $4::text IS NOT NULL AND intent->'scope'=$2::jsonb AND intent->>'owner_id'=$3 AND intent->>'name'=s.name AND ((encode(sha256(decode(r.identity,'hex')),'hex')||'a') COLLATE "C") > $5::text COLLATE "C"
 ORDER BY ((encode(sha256(decode(r.identity,'hex')),'hex')||'a') COLLATE "C") LIMIT $6
) work
ORDER BY work.position COLLATE "C" LIMIT $6
pipeline_exact:
SELECT 1 FROM public.gregale_pipeline_tool_starts
WHERE identity=$1 AND (receipt->'intent')->'scope'=$2::jsonb
 AND (receipt->'intent')->>'owner_id'=$3 AND (receipt->'intent')->>'name'=$4
 AND (receipt->'intent')->>'request_id'=$5 AND (receipt->'intent')->>'subject_id'=$6
 AND (receipt->'intent')->>'contract_sha256'=$7
action_exact:
SELECT 1 FROM public.gregale_outbound_actions
WHERE identity=$1 AND intent->'scope'=$2::jsonb AND intent->>'owner_id'=$3
 AND intent->>'name'=$4 AND intent->>'request_id'=$5
